dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wow, this place is just like the one in that story Boss Nef told me.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: A treasure, hidden in the middle of the desert, that can only be opened with a password...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's just a shame I came here alone. I'm no "master thief." I need a crew...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'm eating well, sleeping well, and living really well. What's not to like?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then why do you have dark circles under your eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Eh? Ehhhh? Is it really that obvious?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Fine, you got me. I hardly slept a wink last night. I was tossing and turning for ages before I finally managed to nod off.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: It's just... Everything here's way too nice! The bed's so soft, the blanket's so light, and it's all so peaceful...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Yeah... That's just how I am. The cozier the place, the less comfortable I get. Makes it impossible to relax and get some real rest.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Even if I try and force myself to sleep, the second I get close, my eyes always snap back open...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Then I either jump up and look around or slide my hand under the pillow to see if anything's there. It's instinctive.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Of course, most of the time, I'm alone and there's nothing under my pillow... So I can lie back down, bathed in a cold sweat, and start to savor the feeling of insomnia.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: When I first arrived at the Curatorium, it was pretty serious. Eventually, I had to sneak out and lie on the lobby couch to get any sleep at all...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: And when I woke up, there was Nef, petting Ashru and smiling at me.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Ugh, it almost scared me to death...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Used to life here yet?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Uhh, not really... But Nef bought me a bunch of... Uh, I can't remember what they're called, but they're some kind of special mat from Inazuma...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: She had them laid out on the floor for me, said I could try sleeping on top of 'em if I ever had trouble sleeping. And that that way, at least I wouldn't get cold.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Hehe, Nef's so good to me. That's why she's the nicest, loveliest, bestest boss in the whole world!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll get you a new bed then.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: I'm fine, really. I've already mastered the art of getting used to a new bed, just give me some time. No need to fuss.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: No prob. What did you want to talk about? Or should I say, what do you want me to teach you?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Lockpicking? Diving? Trap-setting? Mixing laxatives? Or maybe even... some sleight of hand? I can teach it all, you just say the word.

choices.text: Where did you learn all that?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Oh, those are just a few little tricks I picked up along the way... Boss Nef had nothing to do with it. She's got her area of expertise, and I've got mine.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Sure, she's an absolute legend when it comes to the big stuff. Totally unstoppable, crazy resourceful and smart, always ten steps ahead...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: But once she's dealt with the high-level stuff, someone's gotta tie off all the loose ends. That's my time to shine.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Hehe, after all, behind every great boss is a reliable assistant!

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: You don't get to work in the Curatorium of Secrets without a few special skills — even Ashru knows how to wave customers in and show them where to sit.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Still, I don't really know what Nef's thinking, having me as the only full-time employee in the whole place.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: When I first started, I figured we were just understaffed.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Turns out the real heavy hitters in the Curatorium are all lurking in the shadows.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: All Nef has to do is snap her fingers and poof! They appear, and then...

choices.text: Do they all have cool-sounding code names?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Yeah, totally! So you've read that light novel too?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Too bad the Curatorium doesn't have anything like that. Truth is, I really am the only employee.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: *sigh* Boss Nef, O great Boss Nef! Why won't you hire more help? Every day, I'm running all over the place doing errands, and when there's too much, you still have to step in yourself...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: You might not be tired, but I sure am...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}! You're pretty awesome, why don't you come work at the Curatorium? Nef would so...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Oh... no, that's not right...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's not right now?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Knowing Nef, she'd probably say:

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: #"Our long-established partnership with {NICKNAME} is working perfectly well as-is. Why disturb the status quo? Formalizing our collaboration would simply create superfluous admin."

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: It's easy when you spend as much time with her as I do. Still... I—I really wish she'd employ someone else! C'mon, Boss Nef, pretty pleaaase?

choices.text: Are there power rankings and leaderboards?
Was Nefer the one who taught you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Could I... pet that finch for a bit? It's Tubby, right? She's so big, and sooo cute!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'd better ask Tubby herself...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: She can understand!? Wow... I thought only someone special like Lauma would be able to talk to her.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Then... W—What about Chubby? That other finch who sometimes drops by. Can I talk to him, too?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Oh, right, Tubby and Chubby are teapot spirits, not finches...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Anyway, I'm gonna go prep some fruit and take it to Tubby.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: It'll be my first time talking to a teapot spirit... Now, what should I ask about...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Jahoda.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: G—Good morning *yawn*... Last night, I must have slept... Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: ...How long did I sleep for? M'head's all groggy, I can't remember a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Anyway, that bed's way too soft. It'll really take some getting used to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Jahoda.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Good night. I'll hit the hay in a bit. Hmm... Maybe tonight I should try ditching the mattress...?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: This place... It feels so familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh, hey! There's a blacksmith — I can use it to fix up my weapons, and my...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ugh, forget it... Aino's gonna lecture my ears off if I screw it up again...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Maps, bookshelves, this sign...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Whoa! You've got a Curatorium of Secrets here, too!?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Wait, did Boss Nef get you to set this up? I—I didn't come here to take on extra shifts!
